Mindanao co-op members protest Meralco’s planned entry

Hundreds of members of South Cotabato II Electric Cooperative (SOCOTECO II) protested against what they described as a potential takeover attempt by Manila Electric Co. (Meralco), led by Manny Pangilinan.
